rulings.docket_item: Peer escalation (peer_c01.json, row P07-008, span Prov.15.8-Prov.15.9): does the sole adjacent pair among the 11 verses carrying the toevat-YHWH stock formula satisfy the owner's C2 cluster-evidence bar (byte-grounded pair grouping), or is a recurring stock formula categorically theme/formula-only cohesion?
rulings.decision: Cluster stands -- the C2 evidence bar is satisfied; OL's demotion to two single_proverb rows is declined; the escalation is resolved by applying Section 6's own named classes (no owner referral); a mandatory disclosure cure is ordered.
rulings.grounds: Re-derived at every named tier. (1) Skeleton tier, contiguous 2-word construct phrase תועבת יהוה (verse-count unit): 11 verses book-wide -- Prov.3.32, Prov.11.1, Prov.11.20, Prov.12.22, Prov.15.8, Prov.15.9, Prov.15.26, Prov.16.5, Prov.17.15, Prov.20.10, Prov.20.23 -- with Prov.15.8-Prov.15.9 the SOLE adjacent pair (adjacency computed over the sorted hit list). (2) Accent tier, codepoint re-derivation (U+0591 ETNAHTA): etnahta falls on word 4 of 7 in BOTH verses, so the phrase -- pointed תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה at 15:8 words 3-4, תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה at 15:9 words 1-2, byte-spliced -- is colon-1-FINAL in 15:8 and colon-1/verse-INITIAL in 15:9, never in either verse's second colon; the standing colon-position correction (LF + OL + peer, now a fourth independent derivation) is confirmed and stands regardless of the granularity outcome. (3) The evidence-bar application: strategy Section 6 names catchword chains and pair grouping as valid cluster-evidence classes, and its own example list includes the 15:33-16:9 YHWH cluster -- local concentration of a book-recurring stock token -- so book-wide recurrence of a formula is NOT categorically 'theme/formula-only' cohesion; what Section 6 excludes is glue that is theme ALONE. At this seam the glue is wording and construction: (a) a verbatim consecutive multi-word repeat (identical at skeleton and accent-stripped tiers; the pointed forms differ only in accent placement), unique among the 11 sites; (b) a repeated clause template with a second lexical link -- both first cola predicate the phrase of a wicked-genitive subject, זבח רשעים (skeleton) at 15:8 / דרך רשע (skeleton) at 15:9, sharing the רשעים-root (skeleton) on the same pole; (c) a hook position straddling exactly this seam (the phrase closes 15:8's first colon and opens 15:9). Under the carriage standard articulated in B-2, limbs (i) and (ii) are both satisfied -- the evidence carries the cluster. OL's byte-true counterpoint (the formula deployed independently at 9 non-adjacent sites, three of them closing on רצונו [skeleton]) governs DISCLOSURE, not classification: the row's 'sweep: 2 consecutive verses' citation named only the consecutive-pair object and omitted the book-wide digit -- a real understatement defect requiring cure. Not an owner_escalation: this ruling applies Section 6's existing named classes and its own example list to re-derived bytes; no reinterpretation of the law is needed.

consequence.spec: P07-008 retains span Prov.15.8-Prov.15.9 and unit_type proverb_cluster. ONE author-wave edit, integrating the already-queued colon repair: (a) replace the byte-false 'both open their second colon' claim with the accent-verified description -- the phrase is colon-1-final in 15:8 and colon-1/verse-initial in 15:9, a hook straddling the verse boundary; (b) disclose the formula class with object and digit -- contiguous skeleton phrase, 11 verses book-wide, this seam its sole adjacent pair -- so the existing '2 consecutive verses' citation no longer understates book-wide frequency; (c) name the repeated wicked-genitive template (זבח רשעים / דרך רשע, skeleton) as the construction ground. Cure tests (the tests that killed the originals): re-derive the U+0591 ETNAHTA position in both spliced oshb strings and confirm the corrected wording matches; re-run the phrase sweep and confirm the row's stated digits (11 book-wide; sole adjacent pair) exactly; re-collate both quoted Hebrew runs to byte tier via collate.py; citation_sweep.py and check_universals.py GREEN on the revised row.

rulings.docket_item: Cluster-candidacy proposal from the c08 rulings (peer_c08.json, rows P05-041/P05-042, spans Prov.11.8-Prov.11.8 and Prov.11.9-Prov.11.9): the deliverance root occurs exactly twice book-wide, split across this seam, both predicated of the righteous, and both rows' prose denied any match (denials upheld byte-false). Adopt a merge into a proverb_cluster row, or keep two single_proverb rows with a symmetric seam-pair disclosure cure.
rulings.decision: ADOPT the merge: P05-041 and P05-042 are replaced by one proverb_cluster row spanning Prov.11.8-Prov.11.9.
rulings.grounds: CARRIAGE STANDARD for B-2/B-3/B-4 (stated once here; B-3 and B-4 apply it decision-locally): under the Section 6 atomic default, a lexical repetition across an adjacent seam CARRIES a proverb_cluster only when BOTH limbs hold. Limb (i), distributional marking: a NAMED, allography-disciplined object (spelling vs word-bound token vs phrase, per the toolkit's semantic-class count discipline) whose book-wide digit makes the adjacency marked -- rarity plus, normally, the seam being that object's sole adjacent pair. Limb (ii), structural binding: a second byte-visible signal that the repetition is designed pairing rather than ambient collection vocabulary -- a verbatim multi-word repeat, recurrence in the same syntactic slot or clause template (shared construction), or an unambiguous tier-1 connective. A bare lexeme in divergent inflections and slots, however rare, obliges disclosure under the cross-seam cohesion rule but merely PERMITS a cluster; adoption requires the evidence to carry one. This is the bar the part's mesh-ratified clusters already instantiate (P05-039 at 11:5-6: 2-verse-exclusive construct opener in identical verse-initial slot; P05-034 at 10:31-32: 9-verse catchword, sole adjacent pair, plus parallel verse-initial righteous-speech-organ constructs; P05-058 at 11:25-26: 3-verse noun form, sole adjacent pair, pivot of one continuous behavior-reward scheme). APPLICATION to 11:8|11:9, re-derived with tiers named: limb (i) is maximal -- final-form spelling חלץ (skeleton, contiguous) = 1 verse book-wide, Prov.11.8 (pointed נֶחֱלָ֑ץ, byte-spliced); medial-form spelling חלצ (skeleton) = 1 verse, Prov.11.9 (pointed יֵחָלֵֽצוּ); the root's combined attestation is 2 of 915 verses, one on each side of this exact seam -- rarer than every ratified cluster object in the part and trivially its own sole adjacent pair; digits match both primaries and peer_c08's re-derivation exactly. Limb (ii) is satisfied by a repeated predication template: both forms are passive (Niphal) per the pointed byte shapes and the WEB renderings -- “is delivered” (web:Prov.11.8), “will be delivered” (web:Prov.11.9) -- both verbs are clause-final, and both are predicated of the righteous-root subject: singular צדיק (skeleton) in 11:8 colon 1 (צַ֭דִּיק מִצָּרָ֣ה נֶחֱלָ֑ץ, byte-spliced; etnahta word 3 of 6) and plural צדיקים (skeleton) in 11:9 colon 2 (וּ֝בְדַ֗עַת צַדִּיקִ֥ים יֵחָלֵֽצוּ, byte-spliced; verse-final after etnahta at word 4 of 7). Clause shape [righteous subject + prepositional modifier ('out of trouble' / 'by knowledge') + clause-final Niphal deliverance verb] on both sides, with the righteous-root itself a second shared lexical link, and the deliverance clause opening the pair (11:8 colon 1) and closing it (11:9 colon 2). DECISION LOGIC: the rows' denials of any match are already ruled byte-false (peer_c08, both upheld high), so keeping two atomics would require a disclosure cure whose refutation survives the sweep -- and no byte ground exists to refute a book-EXCLUSIVE, same-stem, same-subject-class, clause-final predicate repeat as stock vocabulary (2 of 915 is the opposite of stock). Under the wave's own ratified bar the evidence does not merely permit the cluster; it carries it. The two verses' distinct scenario imagery (substitution vs mouth/knowledge -- both primaries' observation, byte-true) survives as intra-cluster texture, exactly as the two distinct sayings inside ratified P05-034 do.

consequence.spec: Author wave: retire P05-041 and P05-042; author ONE replacement row -- span Prov.11.8-Prov.11.9, unit_type proverb_cluster, parent_collection 'C2 Prov.10.1-Prov.22.16'. Tiling is preserved: P05-040 ends at Prov.11.7-Prov.11.7 and P05-043 begins at Prov.11.10-Prov.11.10 (verified from the combined corpus). The merged rationale must NAME the carrying evidence with objects and digits: final-form spelling חלץ = 1 verse (11:8) / medial-form spelling חלצ = 1 verse (11:9), combined 2 of 915 (skeleton tier, verse-count unit); both passive per pointed bytes and WEB renderings; both clause-final; both predicated of the righteous (צדיק / צדיקים, skeleton). device_notes must record the member verses' distinct scenario imagery (substitution vs mouth/knowledge) as intra-cluster texture, not manufactured uniformity. The driver swap re-opens the dependent fields per the standing rule: rejected_alternative (now rejecting the two-singles reading on the exclusivity digits), observed_substrate_signals, unit_type, confidence (author re-sets on the corrected evidence). boundary_evidence_refs: web:Prov.11.7 and web:Prov.11.10 (the new outer neighbors) plus oshb refs for both member verses. peer_c08's seam-pair disclosure remedies for P05-041/P05-042 are SUPERSEDED -- their substance (disclose the root link with the allography-aware 1+1=2 digit) is absorbed into the merged rationale. Cure tests: (1) both allography sweeps re-run against the revised prose must show each spelling named with its digit (1+1=2) and NO field asserting absent shared wording -- the test that killed the originals; (2) check_tiling.py over Prov.11.1-Prov.11.31 reports 0 gaps/overlaps with the merged row installed; (3) citation_sweep.py, check_refs_mirror.py, check_universals.py, check_marks.py GREEN on the new row; (4) every Hebrew run byte-collated or explicitly tier-labeled per the S-3 cure standard.

rulings.docket_item: Cluster-candidacy from the c09 rulings (peer_c09.json, rows P05-051/P05-052, spans Prov.11.18-Prov.11.18 and Prov.11.19-Prov.11.19): word-bound exact token shared by both verses (the peer's digit reconciliation names the object: word-bound exact 10 vs contiguous-substring 15); P05-052's 'no repeated wording' denial falsified by both primaries. Adopt a merge or direct a symmetric seam-pair disclosure cure.
rulings.decision: DECLINE adoption -- the atomic default holds; symmetric seam-pair disclosure cure ordered (peer_c09's joint work order confirmed as final; its flip-to-cluster branch is closed).
rulings.grounds: The B-2 carriage standard applied to this seam's bytes. Limb (i) IS satisfied, with the controlling object NAMED per peer_c09's digit reconciliation and re-derived here: word-bound exact skeleton token צדקה (unprefixed) = 10 verses book-wide -- Prov.8.20, Prov.11.18, Prov.11.19, Prov.12.28, Prov.13.6, Prov.14.34, Prov.15.9, Prov.16.31, Prov.21.3, Prov.21.21 -- with 11:18-11:19 the sole adjacent pair (adjacency computed); the 15-verse figure is the contiguous-substring object (it adds 5 prefixed-form verses) and is NOT the citation-grade digit for shared wording. Limb (ii) FAILS: the token's slots and constructions diverge -- at 11:18 it is the object of the participle וְזֹרֵ֥עַ (pointed, byte-spliced) inside colon 2 (etnahta word 4 of 8), one pole of an antithetic wage-saying; at 11:19 it is the subject of a verbless outcome clause in colon 1 (etnahta word 3 of 6) after verse-initial כֵּן (pointed). There is no verbatim multi-word repeat and no shared clause template. The only candidate connective, כֵּן, is tier-1-AMBIGUOUS: the row construes it as a backward-leaning conclusion marker ('so/thus') while the WEB witness renders it intra-clausally -- “He who is truly righteous gets life.” (web:Prov.11.19) -- and the staged extract carries no morphology layer to settle the construal; an ambiguous particle cannot serve as the binding signal (and by owner-addendum symmetry, its presence is likewise no counterevidence against atomicity). What remains beyond the single token is the wages-to-life/death thematic progression -- theme glue, which Section 6 names insufficient. Limb (i) without limb (ii) obliges disclosure, not merger: the repeat permits a cluster and does not carry one; the atomic default holds. Decision-local contrasts: B-2's seam has a book-exclusive object PLUS a repeated predication template; ratified P05-058's noun is the pivot of ONE continuous behavior-reward scheme across both verses, whereas 11:19 generalizes to a character-outcome doctrine rather than continuing 11:18's wage scenario. Secondary digit re-derived: לחיים (skeleton) = 4 verses book-wide (Prov.10.16, Prov.10.17, Prov.11.19, Prov.19.23), confirming the peer's correction of the row's implied 2.

consequence.spec: Rows P05-051 and P05-052, symmetric seam-pair disclosure cure: peer_c09's SINGLE joint work order is confirmed as the standing cure, and its open branch ('or flip to proverb_cluster if the boss round finds the shared-noun evidence controlling') is now CLOSED -- the shared-noun evidence is not controlling; unit_type stays single_proverb on both rows; spans unchanged (Prov.11.18-Prov.11.18 / Prov.11.19-Prov.11.19). One authored edit installed symmetrically on both rows: (a) name the shared token with the controlling object and digit -- word-bound exact skeleton token צדקה, unprefixed, 10 verses book-wide, sole adjacent pair here; never the 15-verse prefix-inclusive substring digit; (b) delete the byte-false denials (P05-052's 'share no repeated wording' and 'share no lexical catchword'; P05-051's imagery-only rejection of the 11:19 rival) and re-argue single_proverb from the divergent syntactic slots (object-of-participle in colon 2 vs verbless-clause subject in colon 1) plus the unresolved כֵּן construal; (c) correct the לחיים (skeleton) distributional note to all 4 book-wide sites (Prov.10.16, Prov.10.17, Prov.11.19, Prov.19.23). Cure tests: peer_c09's tests stand (collate.py plus sweep re-runs against the revised prose; no remaining claim of absent shared wording), PLUS the revised prose must carry the 10/word-bound digit with the object named, and check_universals.py and citation_sweep.py must be GREEN on both rows.

rulings.docket_item: Cluster-candidacy from the c06 r1+r2 rulings (rows P05-010/P05-011, spans Prov.10.6-Prov.10.6 and Prov.10.7-Prov.10.7): a rare blessing-root spelling (8 of 915 verses, re-derived and named in the grounds) with adjacent hits at 10:6/10:7, denied by both rows. Adopt a merge or direct a symmetric seam-pair disclosure cure.
rulings.decision: DECLINE adoption -- the atomic default holds; peer_c06_r2's seam-pair disclosure cure is ratified as final, with one strengthening amendment to its citation.
rulings.grounds: The B-2 carriage standard applied to this seam's bytes -- the weakest of the three seams, failing BOTH limbs. Object re-derived and named per allography discipline: the medial-form contiguous skeleton spelling ברכ = 8 verses book-wide -- Prov.10.6, Prov.10.7, Prov.10.22, Prov.11.11, Prov.11.25, Prov.11.26, Prov.24.25, Prov.28.20 -- disjoint from the final-form spelling ברך = 5 verses (Prov.3.33, Prov.20.21, Prov.22.9, Prov.27.14, Prov.30.11); digits match peer_c06_r2 exactly. Limb (i) fails at the decisive point: the 8-hit set contains TWO adjacent pairs -- Prov.10.6-Prov.10.7 AND Prov.11.25-Prov.11.26 (adjacency computed over the sorted list) -- so this seam is NOT the object's sole adjacent pair and adjacency within this object is not distributionally unique. The other adjacent pair is the mesh-ratified P05-058 cluster, which was carried by a DIFFERENT, narrower object -- the noun form ברכה (skeleton), 3 verses book-wide (Prov.10.7, Prov.11.25, Prov.11.26) -- of which 10:6 is not even a member: 10:6's בְּ֭רָכוֹת (pointed, byte-spliced) does not contain that form; only 10:7's לִבְרָכָ֑ה does. Limb (ii) fails outright: non-parallel inflection and slot -- verse-initial plural-absolute subject בְּ֭רָכוֹת in 10:6 colon 1 (etnahta word 3 of 7) vs colon-1-final prefixed-singular predicate לִבְרָכָ֑ה in 10:7 (etnahta word 3 of 6); no shared clause template; no connective; the surrounding righteous/wicked antithesis is chapter-ambient vocabulary (רשעים [skeleton] alone = 42 verses book-wide, peer-verified digit); and 10:6's strongest verbatim tie runs NON-adjacently -- its B-line (ופי רשעים יכסה חמס, skeleton) repeats contiguously at Prov.10.11, texture the row itself already classes as chapter formula rather than local adjacency (re-verified: the 4-token skeleton string is contiguous in 10:11). A cluster here would rest on rarity-diluted, form-divergent, slot-divergent lexical recurrence -- precisely what the atomic default holds against; disclosure with refutation is the correct cure, and here (unlike B-2) the refutation survives the sweep: the link is stock blessing-frame vocabulary whose adjacency recurs elsewhere in the same 8-hit set.

consequence.spec: Rows P05-010 and P05-011, symmetric seam-pair disclosure cure: peer_c06_r2's authored SEAM-PAIR CURE (one edit installed on both rows -- disclose the ברכ-spelling link with the 8-verse digit and the byte forms בְּ֭רָכוֹת / לִבְרָכָ֑ה, refuting it as stock blessing-frame vocabulary in different grammatical forms rather than a distinguishing catchword; no change to unit_type, span, or confidence) is RATIFIED as final, with ONE strengthening amendment: the disclosure's citation must also state that the 8-verse spelling set contains two adjacent pairs book-wide -- this seam and Prov.11.25-Prov.11.26 -- which is the refutation's strongest ground, since adjacency within this object is not unique to this seam. Cure tests: peer_c06_r2's own tests stand unchanged (sweep.py --skel re-run against both revised rows showing the 8-verse digit and the object explicitly named and refuted in each row's own prose; check_universals.py flags no undisclosed adjacent-verse device; citation_sweep.py GREEN on both rows), extended to verify the two-adjacent-pairs disclosure digit.
